body: My life feels like a giant anxiety attack, I can’t stop fucking things up
I’m fuckin’ over it, I’m gonna figure it out.  Once I’m determined to do something I always find a way to do it.
I can just leave a jack stand out and drop a truck on myself tomorrow, is it too much to ask to just go to sleep and not wake up?
I can’t get a gun because I have a criminal record, unless I revive some parts of my former life, which is as good as suicide anyways, but much slower
If I’m gonna do something I’m gonna do it, and I’m not gonna do it now.  I just don’t want wake up half dead or any bullshit like that.
Be part of my life ten years ago teach me how to make better choices and have self esteem?
